question: What was India's rank in the Asia-Pacific Personalised Health Index released by the Economist Intelligence Unit in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 1.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India ranked **10th out of 11 Asia Pacific countries** in a newly-launched** health index to measure the progress** towards personalised healthcare. It highlights the need for improvement in various areas such as policy context, health information, personalised technologies, and health services.
 
• It is encouraging to see that **Singapore, Taiwan, Japan, and Australia **performed well in overall readiness towards personalised healthcare. India can learn from their best practices and work towards improving their own healthcare system.
 
• Personalised healthcare has the potential to improve health outcomes and reduce healthcare costs by tailoring healthcare services to individual needs. It is important for countries to prioritize and invest in this area to improve the overall health and well-being of their citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
